task.title: Archive a resource
task.description: A user may archive a resource that belongs to their own tenant.
acceptanceCriteria: Archiving an active resource sets status to archived and records archivedAt.
Archiving an already-archived resource is a no-op and returns success.
A user cannot archive a resource belonging to another tenant.

testCases.title: Archiving an active resource sets status to archived
preconditions: A resource exists in status 'active' owned by the caller's tenant
testCases.expectedResult: 200 OK; status is 'archived'; archivedAt is set

testCases.title: Archiving a resource in another tenant is rejected
preconditions: A resource exists owned by a different tenant
steps: POST /resources/{id}/archive as a user of tenant B
